name: Penyungsungan Betara Ngerurah
sam3_prompt: low Balinese brick shrine without a roof
description: A roofless brick shrine within the Pura Lingsar complex. It is dedicated to Ratu Ngurah, honored here as Betara Ngerurah.
history: Pura Lingsar is a shared sacred landscape in Lombok, used by Hindu and Sasak Muslim communities. The shrine is recorded as a place of worship and as the abode of Ratu Ngurah.
cultural_meaning: Its purpose is expressed through devotion and care. A simple brick form becomes a place of presence within a living sacred complex.
location: Pura Lingsar, Kabupaten Lombok Barat, Nusa Tenggara Barat, Indonesia
